ModMetaData.name: Eager World Load
ModMetaData.author: ertzfiend
ModMetaData.description:
Eliminates the second loading screen when first opening the world map after loading a save.
In vanilla RimWorld 1.7, new-game generation synchronously generates world layers, but save loading defers layer generation until the world map is first toggled, triggering a disruptive 'Generating planet' loading screen mid-session.
Eager World Load eagerly queues world layer regeneration during save load so that world-view transitions are instantaneous.
